tei:div.tei:p: bhyo/ mdos zor sha khrag gtor ma 'dis// da lta rnal 'byor bdag cag la// sde brgyad chad pa byung ba zlogs// byad zor phur kha thams cad zlogs// lha 'dre'i za kha zug pa zlogs// rgyal po lo yi bdun zur= blon po zla ba'i dbang btsan= dmag mi zhag gi dpung grangs= mtshon cha dus kyi rno ngar= spar kha'i skya mda' zug pa= sme ba dur du tshud pa= sa bdag ko long gdug rtsub= 'byung ba'i dgra gshed 'thab pa= gza' skar dus tshod ngan pa= lo zla zhag dus babs pa= khram dang byad du bcug pa= hom dang par bu bskor pa= dgra chen bdud du langs pa= ltas ngan glo bur ye 'drog= dus min 'chi ba rnam brgyad= mi kha bra mchu thams cad= chag che nyam nga thams cad= sngon sgug phyi nas ded pa= dgra sna phung sna gyod sna= nad sna yams sna rims sna= dgra sri rmi ngan thams cad= che sri chung sri rgas sri= gzhon sri dar sri god sri= gri sri mtshon sri nad sri= mdor na srid pa'i chag sgo dang*// bdag la gnod pa'i dgra bgegs rnams// sdang byed dgra yi steng du zlogs// gnod byed bgegs kyi steng du= bar chad bdud kyi steng du= za 'dre phung 'dre'i steng du zlogs// dam nyams byad ma'i steng du zor/// / ༄༅// bhyo: gzhan yang zlog cing sgyur ba ni: rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la: gnod cing bar du gcod pa yi: ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa bzhi zlogs: yai 'drog sum brgya drug cu= dus min 'chi dang 'jigs brgyad= glo bur bdun brgya nyi shu= bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu= gdon rigs stong phrag bco brgyad= skeg chen sum brgya drug cu= lha chen drag po'i gdug rtsub= lha ma yin gyi rgyu stabs= mgon po'i spar bu bskor pa= gshin rje'i 'phrul 'khor bcas pa= drang srong bram ze'i dmod pa= gza' yi king kang 'phen pa= btsan nad gzer kha gtong ba= sa bdag klu yi mdze nad= bandhe'i 'bum bskor byed pa= sngags pa'i sngags zor 'phen pa=

bon gyi gtso dmar 'phen pa= mu stegs ngan sngags byed pa= byad phur rbod gtong zug pa= mnan gtad sreg 'phang byas pa= mo rtsis rmi lam mtshan ngan= snga zhags mda' ltar 'phen pa= phyi zhags gru gur 'thul ba= mi mthun gnod pa'i phyogs kun= zlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlogs: sgyur ro dpal chen mthu yis sgyur: zor ro dgra dang bgegs la zor: bcom ldan dpal chen khro bo'i tshogs: dam rdzas mchod pa 'di bzhes la: byad dang rbod gtong sgyur ba dang: bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: ces smin gter gshin rje dang gur drag las 'byung ba'i ltas ngan brgya zlog go// /
